title: Sparse Voxels Rasterization: Real-Time High-Fidelity Radiance Field Rendering

We propose an efficient radiance field rendering algorithm that incorporates a rasterization process on adaptive sparse voxels without neural networks or 3D Gaussians. There are two key contributions coupled with the proposed system.
